RTIRQ_NAME_LIST.description: Space-separated list of IRQ thread service names, ordered from higher to lower priority.

RTIRQ_PRIO_HIGH.description: Highest priority level for RT IRQ threads.

RTIRQ_PRIO_DECR.description: Priority decrease step for each subsequent priority level.

RTIRQ_PRIO_LOW.description: Lowest priority level for RT IRQ threads.

RTIRQ_RESET_ALL.description: Whether to reset all IRQ threads to SCHED_OTHER (1=yes, 0=no).

RTIRQ_NON_THREADED.description: Space-separated list of services that should not be threaded.
